title: Bug: Model reverts to gemini-3-flash-preview after cancel and rewind despite gemini-3.1-pro-preview selection

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides clear reproduction details, client environment details, and expected vs actual behavior regarding model selection reverting to flash preview after cancel and rewind operations.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Fixing this bug requires coordinating model sequence state and stream cancellation across packages/core (GeminiClient) and packages/cli (rewind command and stream hooks). Testing requires verifying state synchronization during async stream abort and rewind cycles.

summary.problem: After cancelling a request and rewinding a conversation, the model reverts to gemini-3-flash-preview for subsequent requests despite gemini-3.1-pro-preview being configured and shown as selected.
summary.root_cause: When a request is cancelled or rewound, GeminiClient's internal sticky state (currentSequenceModel) and temporary model fallback overrides are not cleared. As a result, model routing continues to use the sticky sequence model from the cancelled or rewound turn instead of re-evaluating the user's configured model.
summary.context: The CLI UI continues to display gemini-3.1-pro-preview in the footer because config.getActiveModel() returns the primary configured model, but GeminiClient.sendMessageStream prioritizes currentSequenceModel when starting turns.

steps: In packages/core/src/core/client.ts, ensure setHistory and stream cancellation handlers reset currentSequenceModel so sticky sequence model overrides do not persist across rewinds or aborted turns.

In packages/cli/src/ui/commands/rewindCommand.tsx, explicitly invoke client.clearCurrentSequenceModel() during rewindConversation to clear stale model sequence state when jumping back in chat history.
In packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/useGeminiStream.ts, trigger client.clearCurrentSequenceModel() when handling user cancellation or stream aborts.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When a turn is cancelled or a conversation is rewound, clearCurrentSequenceModel() resets sticky sequence model state so subsequent requests correctly route to the user's selected model.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in client.test.ts verifying that calling clearCurrentSequenceModel() or rewinding resets currentSequenceModel to null.
Verify that sending a new message after cancellation/rewind routes to the primary configured model rather than the sticky model from the previous turn.
